open_work: The original 54 identities, six row heights, .30m drawer widths/.22m heights and source wood families remain. Nine columns redistribute within the original counter width and move their fronts toward the room, into a real supported cabinet behind the existing serving face. Hidden source references retain all original poses.

The counter and top retain their original plans and heights. Upper case, rails and drawer supports occupy the existing counter plan; no extension narrows the end approach. Blank ceramic label plates and brass pulls use existing registered catalogue owners, with no generated text.
This is passive fabrication. Drawer operation, medicine/poison custody, stock state, dispensing/fountain operation, continuous service routes and independent utilities retain separate authority.
